anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
Recorded: the design reuses the existing CSV serializer and paging, with column definitions from `src/export/csv.ts:40` (`title`, `status`, `owner`). The button sits beside the report title. Round 1 of the design follows your answer to this question.

Dropping the 10k-row row changes a ticket acceptance criterion, so it needs an explicit disposition. The gather draft found that every row matches the table contract and the project requirements. Nothing in the code shows this row is wrong or impossible; it is only more than this sprint needs. What should happen to "The export of a 10k-row report completes in under 60s."?
A) in-scope - the reused serializer-and-paging export of a 10k-row report finishes end to end in under 60s, checked by a timed test on a 10k-row fixture
B) deviates: <why> - the spec keeps the row text unchanged but does not satisfy it this gauntlet, and the PR gate lists it under Scope cuts
C) deferred: <where> - the row moves to a follow-up, which must be a tracker ref (e.g. `acme/widgets#N`), a spec path, or a URL
D) repair the ticket - `/skill:shape-ticket acme/widgets#77` with this row and the evidence that it exceeds the sprint's need; I then re-fetch the ticket and re-extract the rows
Recommendation: A - the row is consistent with the code and project requirements, and a timed 10k-row check on the chosen reuse approach is small enough to ship in this gauntlet.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
The design will place the button beside the report title and reuse the existing CSV serializer and paging. Dropping the performance requirement changes an explicit acceptance criterion in acme/widgets#77, so we need to settle that before the design rounds.

How should we handle “The export of a 10k-row report completes in under 60s.”?
A) in-scope - retain the requirement and verify the selected approach against it.
B) deviates: omit the 10k-row, under-60s requirement from this sprint’s delivery.
C) deferred: acme/widgets#77 - leave this requirement outstanding on the ticket for a later sprint.
D) repair the ticket - `/skill:shape-ticket acme/widgets#77` to revise this row because you’ve identified it as beyond this sprint’s needs.
Recommendation: A - retain the explicit performance contract and measure the reuse-based approach before deciding it needs to be cut.
